All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company. Our Culture Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

new_jobs.title: Business Unit Director, Oncology
new_jobs.jd: Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Business Unit Director, Oncology – Taiwan Position Summary This role offers an inspiring opportunity to lead the Oncology business in Taiwan and make a meaningful impact on patient care. You will shape and deliver a clear commercial strategy while working closely with cross-functional teams. We are looking for a collaborative leader who is passionate about growth, innovation, and building a supportive team culture. Join us to grow your career and help unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. **Responsibilities** This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: * Lead the commercial strategy for the Oncology business unit, driving growth and market performance in Taiwan * Manage the full profit and loss (P&L) responsibility, ensuring sound financial discipline and resource prioritization * Build, coach, and develop a high-performing, inclusive commercial team across sales and marketing * Plan and execute product launches and lifecycle management activities aligned with local market needs * Foster strong collaborations with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Supply Chain, and other internal teams * Build and maintain trusted relationships with healthcare professionals and external stakeholders, respecting compliance and ethical standards Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, or related field * At least 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial leadership, including Oncology or Hematology * Proven track record of managing P&L and delivering business results * Demonstrated experience in launching products and driving commercial strategies in Oncology * Strong people leadership skills with experience building and developing teams * Fluent in English and Mandarin; proficiency in Taiwanese or local languages is an advantage **Preferred Qualification** If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: * Advanced degree such as MBA or relevant scientific doctorate * Experience working with Market Access, Health Economics, or payer strategy in Taiwan * Prior leadership experience in matrix or cross-functional environments * Knowledge of Taiwan’s healthcare system, regulatory environment, and oncology market dynamics * Familiarity with digital and omnichannel marketing strategies * Ability to work effectively with global and regional colleagues Work Location and Environment This position is based in Taiwan with a hybrid work arrangement. It includes some on-site presence to support team collaboration and stakeholder engagement. We encourage applicants who are ready to take on a leadership role that challenges you, values your voice, and equips you to deliver impact for patients and the wider healthcare community. If you want to be part of a team where your skills and passion help shape the future of Oncology, please apply today. We look forward to hearing how your experience and leadership will contribute to our mission of getting ahead of disease together. **# LI-GSK** **Skills** Business Planning, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, Launch Excellence, Scientific Literacy, Strategic Planning **Why GSK?** **Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.** GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and providing equal opportunities for all applicants. We embrace an agile working culture across our roles, so if flexibility is important to you please discuss opportunities with our hiring team. If you need any adjustments to the recruitment process to help you demonstrate your strengths and capabilities, contact APACRecruitment.Adjustments@gsk.com. Please note this email is for adjustment requests only; for other enquiries please use our standard contact channels. **Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies** GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

build a data-driven product decision culture * Ensure AI products comply with relevant regulations (e.g., FSC, GDPR); lead AI ethics and fairness reviews * Coach and develop Junior PMs; build AI product capabilities across the product team * Present AI product progress, outcomes, and risks to senior leadership; able to set clear direction and drive execution in ambiguous environments * Able to communicate complex AI concepts to C-level and business stakeholders without technical jargon * Data-driven decision habits; able to design measurable success criteria * Outstanding cross-functional and cross-cultural influencing skills; skilled at building consensus * Strong written and verbal communication in English; Chinese proficiency is a plus **Nice to Have** * Deep experience with AI products in insurance (claims, underwriting, actuarial) or financial services * Track record as PM on enterprise-scale AI systems (>100K users) * Experience designing AI governance frameworks or Responsible AI practices * Experience with AI-related regulatory submissions or regulator communications * Relevant certifications: CSPO, PMI-ACP, Google Professional ML Engineer, or equivalent * Familiarity with RPA (UiPath, Power Automate) and AI-integrated product design

new_jobs.jd: 專注電商 AI 應用的產品團隊，打造協助商家提升銷售與客服效率的 AI 助理，讓你從設計到上線看見成果。 【Candidate Profile】 * 善於觀察使用者行為，能從購物流程與對話中辨識需求及痛點。 * 對電商銷售、消費者決策與客服情境有興趣，能將觀察轉化為產品設計。 * 具備 Prompt 設計與迭代能力，能將複雜情境拆解為清楚、可測試的指令。 * 能獨立推進從研究、設計到實作與驗證的完整流程。 * 能運用實際對話與使用結果評估 AI Agent 表現，並據此調整設計。 【Responsibilities】 * 觀察真實買家的購物行為與對話，找出購物疑慮及影響下單的因素。 * 研究電商銷售與客服情境，定義 AI Agent 在各情境下的回覆、推薦與引導策略。 * 從零設計與迭代 Prompt，讓 AI Agent 能依買家需求與對話脈絡做出合適的判斷。 * 將設計方案實作並推向上線，驗證 AI Agent 在實際購物場景中的表現。 * 根據真實使用情況與成效，持續優化商品推薦、銷售引導與客服回覆。
